_comment: Per-band song title aliases for the band-setlist merge rule (lib/bandSetlistMerge.js and its CommonJS twin). Keyed by the band's artist name key (lib/setlistSources.js artistNameKey: 'goose', 'phish', 'grateful-dead'). Each entry maps a title another source uses onto the title the band's own archive uses, so a re-sync treats them as one song and carries the user's rating and comment over. Matching is on normalized titles, so case and punctuation don't matter. Add a pair only after checking both spellings name the same song. For grateful-dead, each pair maps a spelling found on Internet Archive tapes onto the setlist.fm spelling stored on users' shows (checked against those shows on 2026-10-23).

grateful-dead.Memphis Blues Again: Stuck Inside of Mobile With the Memphis Blues Again
grateful-dead.Memphis Blues: Stuck Inside of Mobile With the Memphis Blues Again
grateful-dead.Stuck Inside Of Mobile: Stuck Inside of Mobile With the Memphis Blues Again
grateful-dead.Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad: Going Down the Road Feeling Bad
grateful-dead.Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad: Going Down the Road Feeling Bad
